release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD966A-1200ZK4FD is a bi-spectrum cooled-thermal (MCT MWIR) sphere PTZ with a 640x512 cooled detector and 40-1200 mm thermal zoom, delivering multi-kilometre human/vehicle/ship detection for coastal and critical-infrastructure surveillance. Verified against the official HikMicro datasheet HM-TD966A-1200ZK4FD_T2_Datasheet_en-US_20260817.pdf.
